title: Identity for Applications
description: Learn Amazon Cognito for user authentication in web and mobile applications. Build secure authentication flows.
longDescription: This module covers Amazon Cognito, AWS's managed service for user identity and authentication. You will learn how to set up Cognito User Pools for sign-up and sign-in, use Identity Pools for temporary AWS credentials, and integrate authentication into web and mobile applications with JWT tokens.
whatYouLearn: Set up Cognito User Pools for user authentication
Use Identity Pools for temporary AWS credentials
